question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{-3x^{8}-24}{x^{4}}\,\mathrm{d}x &= \int \left(- 3 x^{4} - \frac{24}{x^{4}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x \\ &=-3\int x^{4}\,\mathrm{d}x-24\int x^{-4}\,\mathrm{d}x \\ &=-3\left(\frac{x^{5}}{5}\right)-24\left(\frac{x^{-3}}{-3}\right)+C \\ &=-\frac{3x^{5}}{5}+\frac{8}{x^{3}}+C.\end{aligned}
$$
